#read all the csv file and create temp view for the same

df_races = spark.read \
    .option("header", "true") \
    .option("inferSchema", "true") \
    .csv("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-rz/races.csv")
df.createOrReplaceTempView("races")
df_races.show()

df_drivers = spark.read \
    .option("header", "true") \
    .option("inferSchema", "true") \
    .csv("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-rz/drivers.csv")
df.createOrReplaceTempView("drivers")
df_drivers.show()


df_results = spark.read \
    .option("header", "true") \
    .option("inferSchema", "true") \
    .csv("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-rz/results.csv")
df.createOrReplaceTempView("results")
df_results.show()

#remove nulls
df_clean_races = df_races.dropna()
df_clean_races.show()


df_clean_results = df_results.dropna()
df_clean_results.show()

df_clean_drivers = df_drivers.dropna()
df_clean_drivers.show()

df_winners = spark.sql("""
    SELECT race_Id, driver_id, points, position
    from results
    WHERE position = 1
""")

df_winners.show()

total_points_df = spark.sql("""
    SELECT driver_Id, SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM results
    GROUP BY driver_Id
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
""")

total_points_df.show()

#arrage results according to positions
df_ordered_results = df_clean_results.orderBy("position")

df_ordered_results.show()

df_clean_results.write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .parquet("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-cz/results.parquet")

df_clean_races.write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .parquet("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-cz/races.parquet")

df_clean_drivers.write\
    .mode("overwrite")\
    .parquet("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-cz/drivers.parquet")

df_parquet_results = spark.read.format("parquet").parquet("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-cz/results.parquet")
display(df_parquet_results)


df_parquet_races = spark.read.format("parquet").parquet("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-cz/races.parquet")
display(df_parquet_races)


df_parquet_drivers = spark.read.format("parquet").parquet("abfss://formula1@strdatadev.dfs.core.windows.net/formula1-cz/drivers.parquet")
display(df_parquet_drivers)
